channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The order book and the stock market split. Dell booked $60.2 billion of AI server orders in its third quarter and ended with a record $132.3 billion AI backlog, lifting full-year revenue guidance to $202 billion, yet the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 7.9 per cent on 24 November and chip stocks kept falling on 25 November as AI financing and rate worries returned. Power, not demand, is the constraint in Europe: Estonia's grid operator has 3.3 GW of data centre requests, nearly twice national peak, XTX opened 22.5 MW in Kajaani while warning that grid permits now take years, and a Google unit sought a 1.2 GW connection in France that RTE says would take seven to eight years. In silicon, Samsung is reported short of HBM base die capacity, with demand seen doubling to about 30,000 wafers a month in 2027. List prices held for a thirteenth straight trading day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69 ahead of Crusoe's posted 1 December step-up.

item.title: Compute brief - 25 November 2026
item.description: The order book and the stock market split. Dell booked $60.2 billion of AI server orders in its third quarter and ended with a record $132.3 billion AI backlog, lifting full-year revenue guidance to $202 billion, yet the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 7.9 per cent on 24 November and chip stocks kept falling on 25 November as AI financing and rate worries returned. Power, not demand, is the constraint in Europe: Estonia's grid operator has 3.3 GW of data centre requests, nearly twice national peak, XTX opened 22.5 MW in Kajaani while warning that grid permits now take years, and a Google unit sought a 1.2 GW connection in France that RTE says would take seven to eight years. In silicon, Samsung is reported short of HBM base die capacity, with demand seen doubling to about 30,000 wafers a month in 2027. List prices held for a thirteenth straight trading day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69 ahead of Crusoe's posted 1 December step-up. Countries: United States: Dell books $60.2 billion of AI orders, record $132.3 billion AI backlog; Army offers nine installations for power-plus-data-centre leases (Wire, 19 to 24 Nov). Estonia: Elering: 3.3 GW of data centre requests, 600 MW signed, 1.3 GW in offers, close to the limit (Wire, 24 Nov, single-source). Finland: XTX opens 22.5 MW in Kajaani; says grid expropriation permits now take years (Wire, 24 Nov). France: Google unit filed a 1.2 GW connection request at Villedieu-sur-Indre; RTE proposal about EUR 67 million, seven to eight years; Google says no decision (Wire, 23 Nov). South Korea: Samsung reportedly short of HBM base die capacity; demand seen at about 30,000 4nm-equivalent wafers a month in 2027 (Wire, 25 Nov, single-source). South Africa: Ramaphosa pitches end-of-life power station sites for AI data centres (Wire, 18 Nov).
